# Domain Rules

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Overview

- **Tribunal** — court with MNI webservice URLs, optional own credential (`login`, `password` encrypted via `Crypt`), `ativo` flag (`App\Models\Tribunal`).
- **Processo** — unique by (`tribunal_id`, `numero_processo`); owns partes (+ representantes), assuntos, prioridades, movimentos, documentos (`App\Models\Processo`).
- **ProcessoDocumento** — MNI document metadata + binary lifecycle `pendente` → `baixado` | `erro`; binary in S3.
- **ApiToken** — external client identity; scopes monitoramentos and credentials.
- **CredencialPje** — encrypted PJe login/senha per (token, tribunal, login).
- **ProcessoMonitoramento** / **ProcessoMonitoramentoExecucao** — periodic polling subscription and its run history.
- **ProcessoExportacao** — PDF export job record `enfileirado` → `processando` → `concluido` | `falhou`.
- **CNJ reference data** — `cnj.assuntos`, `cnj.classes`, `cnj.orgaos`; `tipos_documentos` per tribunal.

### Número do processo normalization

- `cleanNumeroProcesso()` (`app/Helpers/functions.php`): `trim`, remove `.` and `-`.
- `0000832-35.2024.4.01.3200` → `00008323520244013200` (asserted in `MonitoramentoProcessoControllerTest`).
- Applied in `prepareForValidation()` of `CriarMonitoramentoProcessoRequest`, `CriarExportacaoProcessoRequest`, and in every `Api\ConsultarProcessoController` / `Api\DocumentoController` action except `DocumentoController::show`.

### API token authentication

- Plain token `mni_` + 48 random chars (`ApiToken::generatePlainToken`); stored as `hash('sha256', $plain)` in `api_tokens.token`.
- Plain value shown once: flashed as `token` after `ApiTokenController::store`.
- Valid = `ativo = true` AND (`expires_at` null OR `> now()`) (`scopeValido`).
- `registrarUso()` writes `last_used_at` at most once per minute, without touching `updated_at`.
- Failure → 401 `{"message": "Token inválido ou não fornecido"}` (`ValidateApiToken`).

### PJe credential resolution

Consulta routes (`ValidateApiToken` + `InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao`) → `ConsultarProcessoService` (MNI):

| Request `login_pje` + `senha_pje` | Env pair `PJE_LOGIN_PADRAO`/`PJE_SENHA_PADRAO` | Credential sent to MNI |
|---|---|---|
| both filled | any | request pair |
| one or none filled | both set | env pair (whole pair; never mixed) |
| one or none filled | missing/incomplete | `tribunal->login` + `Crypt::decrypt(tribunal->password)` |
| — | — | decrypt fails → `MNIException('Credenciais MNI/PJ-e tribunal inválidas.', 422)` |

Monitoramento routes (`ValidateApiToken` only; `routes/api.php` comment: env pair must not be persisted as frozen copy):

| Body `login_pje` + `senha_pje` | Stored | Used at execution (`ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob::resolverCredenciais`) |
|---|---|---|
| only one present | — | 422 (`required_with` on both fields) |
| both present | `CredencialPje` upserted by (`api_token_id`, `tribunal_id`, `sha256(login)`); `senha` updated if different | stored pair |
| both absent on create | `credencial_id = null` | env pair read fresh from config; missing → `null, null` → tribunal credential |
| both absent on update | current `credencial_id` kept | unchanged |

Extend: new credential source → add a branch in `CredencialPjeService::resolver` (persisted) or `InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao` (per request).

### Credential storage and masking

- `credenciais_pje.login` / `senha` cast `encrypted` (APP_KEY); unique (`api_token_id`, `tribunal_id`, `login_hash`).
- Rotating `APP_KEY` invalidates stored credentials (README).
- `login_mascarado`: length < 8 → `******`; else first 3 + `*` × (len − 6) + last 3 → `12345678900` → `123*****900`.

### Monitoramento lifecycle

| Status | Meaning | Enters via | Leaves via |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ativo` | picked by dispatcher when due | create; PATCH `status=ativo`; new credential while `suspenso` | PATCH `pausado`; 5 consecutive failures; DELETE |
| `pausado` | human pause; never auto-resumed | PATCH `status=pausado` | PATCH `status=ativo`; DELETE |
| `suspenso` | `falhas_consecutivas` ≥ `max_falhas_consecutivas` (5) | `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob::registrarFalha` | new credential (POST/PATCH); PATCH `status=ativo`; DELETE |
| `cancelado` | terminal; row soft-deleted | DELETE (→ 204) | — |

Rules (`Api\MonitoramentoProcessoController`, `config/pje.php`):

- One live (`ativo`/`pausado`/`suspenso`) monitoramento per (`api_token_id`, `tribunal_id`, `numero_processo`); Postgres partial unique index `processo_monitoramentos_ativo_unico WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 'cancelado'`.
- `POST` is upsert: live match → update, 200; else create with `proxima_execucao_em = now()`, 201. Concurrent duplicate → `UniqueConstraintViolationException` → update path.
- Limit: 500 live per token (`PJE_MONITORAMENTO_MAX_ATIVOS_POR_TOKEN`), checked only when creating → 422 `Limite de monitoramentos ativos por token atingido`.
- `intervalo_horas` 1..720; `tribunal_id` must exist with `ativo = true`.
- uuid owned by another token → 404.
- `POST /{uuid}/executar` → `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob` on `monitoramento` immediately, 202; status not checked.

Update matrix (`aplicarAtualizacao`, shared by PATCH and repeated POST; absent field = untouched):

| Condition | Effect |
|---|---|
| `intervalo_horas` changed AND `ultima_execucao_em` set | `proxima_execucao_em = ultima_execucao_em + novo intervalo`; past → `now()` |
| new credential id ≠ current | `falhas_consecutivas = 0`; `proxima_execucao_em` future → `now()` |
| new credential AND status `suspenso` | `status = ativo` (unless request sets status), `bloqueado_ate = null` |
| same credential re-sent | no reschedule, no status change |
| `status=ativo` from non-`ativo` | `falhas_consecutivas = 0`, `bloqueado_ate = null`, `proxima_execucao_em = now()` |
| `pausado` + new credential | stays `pausado` |

### Dispatch and execution

- `vencidos()`: `status = ativo` AND `proxima_execucao_em <= now()` AND (`bloqueado_ate` null OR `< now()`).
- `monitoramentos:despachar` (every 30 min, `withoutOverlapping`): chunks of 200 under `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`; sets `bloqueado_ate = now + 120 min` and `proxima_execucao_em = now + intervalo_horas` before dispatch.
- Queue `monitoramento` runs 1 worker in every environment (`config/horizon.php`) → tribunal queried one processo at a time.
- `ExecutarMonitoramentoProcessoJob`: `$tries = 1` (reschedule belongs to dispatcher), `$timeout = 600`.
  - `dataReferencia` = day before stored `data_referencia` (`Ymd`); null on first run → `ProcessoService` default 90 days ago.
  - Query with `baixar_binarios = false` (metadata only).
  - Success → execução `sucesso`; monitoramento `ultima_execucao_em = now`, `data_referencia = today`, `falhas_consecutivas = 0`, `bloqueado_ate = null`.
  - Any `Throwable` → execução `falha`, `erro_resumo` ≤ 1000 chars (`MNIException::getError()` preferred); `falhas_consecutivas + 1`; ≥ 5 → `suspenso`; `bloqueado_ate = null`.
  - Webhook dispatched after every run, success or failure.
- `monitoramentos:limpar-execucoes --dias=90` (daily 04:30) deletes execuções older than N days in batches of 1000; `--dias` < 1 → failure.

### Change detection

- `DetectarAlteracoesProcessoService::snapshot()` before the query: `identificador_movimento` and `id_documento` lists; processo absent → `existia = false`.
- `delta()` after the query: rows not in snapshot.
- `primeira_execucao = !existia`; `houve_alteracao` = any new movimento or documento.
- Lists capped at `limite_itens_payload` (500); counters keep real totals; `truncado = true` when either list exceeds the cap.
- Dates as ISO-8601; `codigo_nacional` cast to int.

### Webhook delivery

- `callback_url` (`CallbackUrlValidator`, at validation and before each send): scheme `https`, host present, not `localhost`, resolved IP outside private and reserved ranges.
- `CallbackNotifier::notificar`: POST JSON, timeout 10 s, header `X-API-Token: {callback_token}` overrides extras.
- 2xx → success; 4xx → `CallbackPermanentException` → job fails, no retry; 5xx/network → exception → queue retry.
- Monitoramento + export webhooks: `$tries = 5`, backoff 10 s, 60 s, 300 s, 900 s, 3600 s; skip when `webhook_enviado_em` set; `webhook_tentativas` incremented per attempt.
- Webhook still sent when monitoramento is soft-deleted (`withTrashed()`).
- Re-send: `monitoramentos:reenviar-webhook {execucao_id?}`, `exportacoes:reenviar-webhook {exportacao_id?}`; no id → rows with `webhook_enviado_em` null created > 1 h ago; `--reset-tentativas`, `--force`.

### MNI message standardization

`PadronizarMensagemMniService::REGRAS` — case-insensitive substring match, first rule wins, unmatched text passes through, idempotent; applied in `MNIException::__construct`.

| Substrings (lowercase) | Output |
|---|---|
| `erro ao realizar login via mni`, `loginfailed` | `Erro ao realizar login via MNI. Verifique suas credenciais.` |

- `loginfailed` also decides the 403 `credencial_pje_recusada` on `GET /processo/visualizar` and `GET /documento/visualizar` (see "Erros com código estável (DEP-01)"). That check lives outside `REGRAS`, in `ClassificarFalhaMniService::credencialRecusada`, and runs on the raw text before this normalization; `erro ao realizar login via mni` alone does not trigger the 403.

Extend: append `['trechos' => [...lowercase...], 'mensagem' => '...']` to `REGRAS`.

### Processo persistence and caching

- `ProcessoService::consultarNumero`: SOAP `consultarProcesso` with documentos + cabeçalho + movimentos; default `data_referencia = date('Ymd', -90 days) . '000001'`.
- Upsert keys: `Processo` (`tribunal_id`, `numero_processo`); `ProcessoMovimento` (`processo_id`, `identificador_movimento`, unique index); `ProcessoDocumento` (`processo_id`, `id_documento`, unique index); `ProcessoAssunto` (`processo_id`, `assunto_codigo`); `ProcessoPrioridade` (`processo_id`, `descricao`).
- Linked documents (`documentoVinculado`) saved as their own `ProcessoDocumento` rows.
- Read endpoints serve the DB copy first:

| Endpoint | DB hit | DB miss |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /processo/consultar` (by número) | return page + dispatch `BaixarProcessoMNIJob` | sync `consultarNumero` |
| `GET /processo/visualizar` | return + dispatch `BaixarProcessoMNIJob` | sync `consultarNumero` |
| `GET /processo/dados-basicos` | return | sync `consultarDadosBasicos` |
| `GET /processo/movimentos/listar` | return when ≥ 1 movimento | sync `consultarMovimentos` |
| `GET /processo/documentos/listar` | return when ≥ 1 documento | sync `consultarDocumentos` |

### Document binary download

- Queued when `baixar_binarios = true` and status ≠ `baixado`: `BaixarDocumentoMNIJob` on `mni-download`, unique per documento id for 1800 s.
- Routing by `mimetype` (`SalvarDocumentoProcessoService::baixarDocumento`):

| mimetype | Handler | S3 object(s) under `documentos-processos/{numero_processo}/` |
|---|---|---|
| `text/html` | `downloadHTML` → DomPDF render | `{id}.pdf` + `{id}.html` (`path_html`) |
| `application/pdf` | `downloadPDF` | `{id}.pdf` |
| `video/mp4` | `downloadMP4` | `{id}.{ext}` |
| `video/quicktime` | `downloadQuicktime` | `{id}.{ext}` |
| `audio/*` | `downloadAudio` | `{id}.{ext}` |
| other | `downloadOutros` | `{id}.{ext}` from `getFileExtension()`; unknown → `dat` |

- Success → `status = baixado`, `path`, `downloaded_at = now()`. Failure → `status = erro`, `tentativas_download + 1`, exception rethrown. `erro` reset to `pendente` on next attempt.
- `mni:baixar-documento-pendente` re-queues every `erro` documento.
- HTML S3 writes retry 3 times with 1 s sleep (`putComRetry`).

### Document visualization

- `GET /documento/visualizar`: missing documento → full `consultarNumero` then retry lookup; still missing → `MNIException('Documento não encontrado', 404)`.
- Up to 3 attempts to obtain a 60-min presigned S3 `link`; none → 404 `Não foi possível obter o documento {id} do processo {numero} após 3 tentativas`.
- `conteudo_html` attached only to the response (from DB column or S3 `path_html`), never persisted; missing HTML object for `text/html` → one self-heal `downloadHTML`.
- Client pair refused (`loginfailed`) → 403 `credencial_pje_recusada`; `Processo de número <dígitos> não encontrado!` → 404 `processo_nao_encontrado`. Both stop the 3-attempt loop. Rules and exclusions in the next section.

### Erros com código estável (DEP-01)

Scope: `GET /processo/visualizar` and `GET /documento/visualizar` only. Status decided in `app/Http` (`App\Http\Responses\ErroComCodigo`); services only throw typed exceptions.

| Raw MNI signal | Condition | Response |
|---|---|---|
| `loginfailed` (case-insensitive) in `sucesso = false` `mensagem` or in SoapFault/exception text | call used the pair sent by the client | 403 `{"codigo": "credencial_pje_recusada", "message": "Credencial PJe recusada pelo tribunal"}` |
| `sucesso = false` with `mensagem` matching `^Processo de número \d+ não encontrado!$` (whole text) | any credential | 404 `{"codigo": "processo_nao_encontrado", "message": "Processo não encontrado no tribunal"}` |

- Detection on the raw text, before `MNIException` normalization: `ClassificarFalhaMniService` (`credencialRecusada`, `processoNaoEncontrado`, `PADRAO_PROCESSO_NAO_ENCONTRADO`).
- `Intercomunicacao\ConsultarProcessoService::execute` and `ConsultarDocumentoService::execute` throw `CredencialPjeRecusadaException` / `ProcessoNaoEncontradoNoTribunalException` (extend `MNIException`; `getCode()` 500; `getError()` normalized as before). Recusa is classified only when `login_pje` and `senha_pje` are both non-null.
- Client pair: `InjectCredenciaisPjePadrao` sets request attribute `credenciais_pje_do_cliente` (`ATRIBUTO_PAR_DO_CLIENTE`) to `true` only when the request brings both `login_pje` and `senha_pje`; `false` when it injects the env pair or nulls them.
- `ErroComCodigo::classificar($e, $parDoCliente)` walks `$e` and `getPrevious()`: "não encontrado" always maps; recusa only with `$parDoCliente`. `ErroComCodigo::resposta()` uses fixed literals, never the tribunal text.
- Covered MNI calls: sync `consultarNumero` (processo/visualizar DB miss; documento/visualizar documento missing) and the binary download of `/documento/visualizar` (`downloadPDF`, `downloadHTML`, `downloadAudio`, `downloadOutros`). Download wrappers keep their message and chain the original as `previous`; `consultarDocumento` rethrows typed exceptions unwrapped; `DocumentoController::getDocumento` rethrows the classified one. No extra SOAP call; no retries after a classified failure.
- Exclusions (response exactly as before, no `codigo`):
  - refusal of the env pair (`PJE_LOGIN_PADRAO`/`PJE_SENHA_PADRAO`) or of the tribunal credential → 500 with normalized text;
  - refusal text without `loginfailed` (e.g. `Erro ao realizar login via MNI.`); any other `mensagem` (sigilo, `Processo não encontrado`, missing `!`, prefixed text); "não encontrado" text arriving as SoapFault;
  - legacy `text/html` (`baixado`, no `path_html`/`conteudo_html`) re-fetch in `baixarDocumento` (tribunal credential; `previous` chain cut on purpose) → 500 `Erro ao processar documento HTML:`;
  - complementary HTML recovery in `DocumentoController` → 200 with `conteudo_html = null`;
  - `video/mp4` / `video/quicktime` download (`scripts/mni_consultar_documento.sh`) → unchanged;
  - processo already in DB on `/processo/visualizar` → 200 + `BaixarProcessoMNIJob`, no sync MNI call;
  - 404 after 3 attempts without link → `{message}` without `codigo`;
  - all other endpoints, webhooks and monitoramento `erro_resumo`.

### Sigla e grau do tribunal (DEP-02)

- `tribunais.sigla` follows the CNJ-derived format the API client compares against (`Tribunal::REGEX_SIGLA`, same `pattern` as schema `Tribunal.sigla` in `docs/api/openapi.yaml`): STF, STJ, STM, TST, TSE, TJDFT, `TRF1`–`TRF6`, `TRT1`–`TRT24`, `TRE-<UF>`, `TJ<UF>`, `TJM<UF>`.
- Several active rows may share a `sigla` (e.g. TJAP PJe 1º and 2º grau, separate MNI endpoints); `grau` (`"1"`, `"2"`, null) tells them apart and the client lets the user pick the row. No uniqueness constraint on `sigla`.
- Admin (`TribunalRequest`): `sigla` required, trimmed and uppercased before the regex; `grau` nullable, `in:1,2`.
- Migration `2026_10_08_120000_add_sigla_grau_to_tribunais_table` backfills only rows with `sigla` null, from the start of `nome` (`grau` from `1º`/`2º grau`); underivable rows stay null and are logged (`tribunais: sigla não derivável do nome`). It also fixes `tipo` `Superior Tribunal de Justiça (STJ)` → `Tribunal de Justiça` on `TJ<UF>`/`TJDFT` rows; `down()` drops the columns without reverting `tipo`.

### Export document selection

`ExportacaoProcessoService::queryDocumentos` — base: documentos of `numero_processo` with `status = baixado`, `mimetype` in (`application/pdf`, `text/html`), `path` not null; ordered by `id_documento` asc.

| Filters present | Selection |
|---|---|
| `ids_selecionados` non-empty | `id_documento IN ids` (other filters ignored) |
| `periodo_inicial` + `periodo_final` | `data_hora BETWEEN 'ini 00:00:01' AND 'fim 23:59:59'` |
| `id_inicial` + `id_final` | `id_documento BETWEEN` |
| período + id range | both applied (AND) |
| none | all base documentos |

- No match at request time → 404, no record created. No match at job time → `marcarComoFalhou('Nenhum documento encontrado para os filtros informados.')`.
- PDF: DomPDF cover (`processo.download` view, bookmark `Capa`) + each document merged with FPDI, bookmark = `descricao`; each source normalized to PDF 1.4 by Ghostscript, original kept on gs failure; unreadable document skipped with warning.

Extend: add a filter key to `CriarExportacaoProcessoRequest::rules`, `ExportacaoProcessoService::criar` (`filtros` JSON) and `queryDocumentos`.
